question: Who among the following never became United Nation’s Secretary General?
solution:
The correct answer is** Louise Frechette.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On the **Security Council's proposal,** the General Assembly appoints the Secretary-General.
 
• Therefore, any of the **Security Council's five permanent members** may veto the Secretary-appointment. General's
 
• Canadian diplomat and public servant** Louise Frechette held the position of Deputy Secretary-General of the United Nations for eight** years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• From **1997 to 2006, Kofi Annan,** a diplomat from Ghana, held the position of seventh Secretary-General of the United Nations.
 
• Between **2007 to 2016, South Korean politician and diplomat Ban Ki-moon **held the position of eighth Secretary-General of the United Nations.
 
• From **April 1953 to September 1961, the second Secretary-General of the United Nations was Dag Hammarskjold,** a diplomat, and economist from Sweden.
